NAME: NORMAL, UNFILTERED
WHAT RUNS: One train. NO FILTER BYPASS IS SHOWN ON S-06 - see HV-D1

NAME: FILTERED / PROTECTIVE
WHAT RUNS: One train through the full filter set, second train standby

NAME: CLOSED
WHEN: detonation to all-clear, or a filter change
WHAT RUNS: All five blast valves shut. Soda lime and O2 only. 48 h limit

NAME: PURGE
WHAT RUNS: 5 air changes of decon stage 1: 12.8 min, 4-5 persons per hour

NAME: GENERATOR RUNNING
WHAT RUNS: BV-4 and BV-5 open. Bay 8 only - does NOT touch the gas-tight envelope
